import codecs,json,sys,unicodedata
assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3,14,7)
assert unicodedata.unidata_version == '16.0.0'
rows=json.load(sys.stdin)
name=None
fault=None
def decode(data,errors='strict'):
    global fault
    message=codecs.raw_unicode_escape_decode(bytes(data).split(b'\n')[1])[0]
    fault=getattr(__builtins__,name)(message)
    raise fault
codecs.register(lambda encoding:(None,decode,None,None) if encoding=='point_fault' else None)
results=[]
for row in rows:
    name=row['name']
    try:
        compile(row['source'].encode('ascii'),'point-fault.py',row['mode'])
    except BaseException as error:
        result={'type':type(error).__name__,'points':list(map(ord,error.args[0])),'same':error is fault}
        if isinstance(error,SyntaxError):
            result.update(filename=error.filename,line=error.lineno,offset=error.offset,text=error.text,msgAlias=error.msg is error.args[0])
        results.append(result)
print(json.dumps(results))
